description: Convert a Word document (.docx, or best-effort .doc) into md2sign markdown. Keeps headings, bold and italics, numbered and bulleted lists, tables and links; images are dropped. Nothing is saved: review the returned markdown, add a [[signature: Name <email>]] field for each person who needs to sign (see signing_advice), then call create_draft. Returns markdown, title, import_warnings and validation. Max 10 MB.

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is accepted).

filename.description: Original file name, e.g. "Services Agreement.docx". Optional.

name: import_word_document
title: Import a Word document
